scripts:
create service user gradial-obo-state with path system/gradial
create path (sling:Folder) /var/gradial/obo/grants
create path (sling:Folder) /var/gradial/obo/consents
set ACL for everyone
  deny jcr:read,rep:write on /var/gradial/obo
end
set ACL for administrators
  allow jcr:read,rep:write on /var/gradial/obo
end
set ACL for gradial-obo-state
  allow jcr:read,rep:write on /var/gradial/obo
  allow jcr:read on /home/users restriction(rep:ntNames,rep:AuthorizableFolder,rep:User)
  deny jcr:read on /home/users restriction(rep:itemNames,rep:password)
  allow jcr:read on /home/groups restriction(rep:ntNames,rep:AuthorizableFolder,rep:Group,rep:MemberReferencesList,rep:MemberReferences)
end
